2026 Verification & Math Transparency

How Whatnot Fees Works (2026 Formula & Worked Example)

When to use this tool: Use this tool BEFORE going live on Whatnot so you know your exact mathematical Break-Even Start Bid across Standard (8%), Electronics (5%), and Coins & Money (4%) categories—including amortized viewer giveaway labels.

Exact Formula: Commission = Hammer Price × Category Rate (8%/5%/4%). Processing Basis = Hammer Price + Buyer Ship + Est. Buyer Tax. Processing = Basis × 2.9% + $0.30. Net Profit = Hammer Price − Commission − Processing − COGS − Amortized Giveaway/Packing.

Worked 2026 Example: $25 Winning Bid (8% Apparel/Cards, $4.50 Ship, $9 COGS)

  • Commission takes $2.00 + processing (on $31.57 tax-inclusive basis) takes $1.22 = $3.22 total Whatnot fees (12.9%). Subtracting $9.00 COGS and $0.85 giveaway allocation leaves $11.93 net profit.
  • Exact break-even start bid is $11.58—so running risky "$1 starts" in a small room under 25 bidders can easily lose money.

Frequently Asked Questions (Whatnot Fees)

How are Whatnot US seller fees calculated in 2026?

Whatnot charges an 8% commission on the item sale price (4% for Coins & Money, 5% for Electronics) PLUS a 2.9% + $0.30 payment processing fee calculated on the buyer’s entire checkout total (item + shipping + sales tax).

Should Whatnot sellers include giveaway shipping inside per-order math?

Yes! Because sellers pay the shipping label on every viewer giveaway (~$4.50 each), dividing total show giveaway costs by expected paid orders prevents surprise margin wipeouts.

Why does Whatnot’s 2.9% processing fee look higher than 2.9% of my winning bid?

Because payment processors charge 2.9% + $0.30 on the ENTIRE checkout charge (item + buyer shipping + state sales tax), which pushes effective processing on a $15–$25 auction to ~4.5%–5.5% of the hammer price.

How should I calculate giveaway cost per paid order?

If you run 5 viewer giveaways per show costing $4.50 postage + $2.00 item ($32.50 total) and expect 40 paid orders, enter $0.81 in the Giveaway Allocation field.
